# Refined X4 Pro panel spacing

This release fine-tunes the reader panel dimensions for the X4 Pro display's physical top-edge crop.

## Improved

- Reduced the bottom reader panel by 6 pixels, removing 3 pixels from both its top and bottom spacing.
- Added 6 pixels above the top-panel content so the clock and battery remain comfortably visible on cropped displays.
- Adjusted the book viewport to match the new panel dimensions without changing book typography or line layout.

## Notes

- This is an X4 Pro-only firmware release containing only `firmware-x4pro.bin`.
